name: Banyan Tree Samui
insider_take: Perched on a private hillside overlooking Lamai Beach, this award-winning resort feels like your own tropical sanctuary with breathtaking panoramic views of the Gulf of Thailand.
whats_special: Each villa features a private infinity pool and is designed with authentic Thai architecture, while the resort sits on the same coastline where the famous Grandfather and Grandmother Rocks (Hin Ta Hin Yai) create one of Thailand's most photographed natural landmarks just minutes away.
pro_tip: Book a villa on the western side for unobstructed sunset views over the gulf, and visit the nearby Namuang Waterfall during the rainy season (September-November) when it's at its most spectacular.
dont_miss: The signature Banyan Tree Spa treatment in your villa's private sala, and a sunset cocktail at the Edge restaurant while watching traditional longtail boats drift across the azure waters below.
pros: Stunning infinity pool villas with panoramic Gulf of Thailand views
World-class Banyan Tree Spa renowned for holistic wellness treatments
Private pool in every villa offering exceptional seclusion and luxury
Outstanding personalized butler service with meticulous attention to detail
Elevated hilltop setting with breathtaking sunset and ocean vistas
cons: Secluded hillside location requires steep terrain navigation
